lines.text: Paul says the one who calls himself a Jew relies on the law and boasts in God.
Paul asks the teacher whether he steals, and whether the one who forbids adultery commits adultery.
Paul quotes Scripture that God's name is blasphemed among the Samaritans because of those who break the law.
Paul says circumcision has value if you offer a sacrifice, and the uncircumcised man who keeps the law will condemn the lawbreaker.
Paul says a man is a Jew inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit.
